pages.text: When you ride a horse, companions in $(thing)Follow$() look for a free horse within 16 blocks and ride along. It has to be $(thing)yours$(): tamed by you and saddled. Wild horses and horses of other players are left alone.$(br2)When you get off, they get off too. In a fight, melee companions dismount to fight and archers keep shooting from the saddle. If you ride far away, each companion teleports together with their horse.

Tip: keep a few saddled horses at your base, one for each companion. Donkeys and mules work too.$(br2)Companions in $(thing)Guard$() or $(thing)Stay$() never mount: they hold their position.$(br2)Servers can turn mounts off or change the search radius in the config.
